title: Church Planting
definition: Church Planting is the mission work of establishing new local churches where believers gather, grow, worship, and witness under Christ.
summary: The Gospel mission includes forming local churches for discipleship and witness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ builds His Church and sends His people to make disciples among the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Planting teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the gospel mission includes forming local churches for discipleship and witness.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Planting calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church planting move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
